decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's water-control portfolio, it is still an open option after only one year and can be kept at modest cost, but its limited website prominence suggests a meaningful chance of withdrawal if project demand stays weak.

This product fits the firm's strategic move toward digitally networked, energy-efficient infrastructure and, as a software-based system building on existing capabilities, is worth keeping while market feedback continues to develop.

Its dedicated product page signals a stronger commercial commitment, and as a close fit with the firm's established hydraulic infrastructure business it is likely to stay unless early orders clearly disappoint.
